boundaries.claims: Category-linked exploratory evidence; no forced category, universal erasure, or assumed method novelty.

round.name: r1
round.purpose: Compare traditional parameter repairs, with identical interventions on matched historical SHAM models.

data.historical_exposure: E1 construct128, bank128 and search-v2 train/dev; all E2 cohorts including D4
limitations: All questions passed existing review, not expert gold certification.
Historical chapters may recur, but historical IDs and stems never recur.
E3 repair/dev/confirm have disjoint chapters, stems and Target lexical components.
Remaining Utility covers five subjects; this is not unseen-subject evaluation.
data.sampling: whole chapter/stem/Target lexical-component assignment, then least-filled-subject sampling
